# zed-mcp

> MCP server for Zed editor — settings, extensions, themes, projects, open files.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — Full reference
- [README.md](README.md) — Setup and usage
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — Version history

## Quick Start

```
uv run zed-mcp
```

Requires Python 3.11+ and Zed editor installed.
